title: Local Ad
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Michael Scott announces and leads the creation of Dunder Mifflin's first television commercial, navigating conflicts with the ad agency and corporate while rallying the office staff to produce an in-house ad. Despite initial rejection of his artistic vision by corporate, Michael directs a new commercial with the help of Jim and Pam, which is well received by the office. Meanwhile, Andy seeks advice from Dwight about advancing his relationship with Angela. The episode highlights Michael's determination to prove his creativity and the office's collaborative efforts in the ad production.

main_threads.thread: Michael's efforts to create Dunder Mifflin's first commercial, including conflicts with the ad agency and corporate, and the eventual in-house production and premiere of the commercial.
